actinic_keratosis.name: Actinic Keratosis
actinic_keratosis.description: Rough, scaly patches on skin caused by years of sun exposure. Considered a precancerous condition.

basal_cell_carcinoma.name: Basal Cell Carcinoma
basal_cell_carcinoma.description: Slow-growing skin cancer that usually appears on sun-exposed areas. Rarely spreads but requires treatment.

darier_disease.name: Darier's Disease
darier_disease.description: A genetic skin disorder causing rough, warty bumps that can be brown, yellow, or white.

dermatofibroma.name: Dermatofibroma
dermatofibroma.description: Common benign skin growth that usually appears on legs, firm to touch and slightly raised.

epidermolysis_bullosa.name: Epidermolysis Bullosa
epidermolysis_bullosa.description: A group of rare genetic conditions causing fragile skin that blisters easily.

hailey_hailey.name: Hailey-Hailey Disease
hailey_hailey.description: A hereditary blistering disorder affecting folds of skin like armpits, groin, and neck.

herpes_simplex.name: Herpes Simplex
herpes_simplex.description: Viral infection causing cold sores or fever blisters, typically around mouth or genitals.

impetigo.name: Impetigo
impetigo.description: Highly contagious bacterial skin infection common in children, causing sores and honey-colored crusts.

larva_migrans.name: Larva Migrans
larva_migrans.description: Skin disease caused by hookworm larvae burrowing through the skin, creating itchy track lines.

leprosy.name: Leprosy (Hansen's Disease)
leprosy.description: Chronic infectious disease affecting skin and nerves. Highly treatable but requires extended medical care.

lichen_planus.name: Lichen Planus
lichen_planus.description: Inflammatory skin condition causing itchy, purple-colored bumps on skin and inside the mouth.

lupus.name: Lupus Erythematosus
lupus.description: Autoimmune disease where the immune system attacks healthy tissue, causing rashes and skin damage.

melanoma.name: Melanoma (Skin Cancer)
melanoma.description: The most serious type of skin cancer that develops in pigment-producing cells. Early detection is critical.

molluscum_contagiosum.name: Molluscum Contagiosum
molluscum_contagiosum.description: Viral skin infection causing small, painless, pearly bumps that can spread through contact.

mycosis_fungoides.name: Mycosis Fungoides
mycosis_fungoides.description: A type of cutaneous T-cell lymphoma (skin cancer) that starts as a rash and progresses slowly.

neurofibromatosis.name: Neurofibromatosis
neurofibromatosis.description: Genetic condition causing tumors to grow on nerves and skin, with café-au-lait spots.

papilomatosis.name: Papillomatosis (Confluent and Reticulate)
papilomatosis.description: Skin condition causing brown, scaly patches that join together, often on the chest and neck.

pediculosis_capitis.name: Pediculosis Capitis (Head Lice)
pediculosis_capitis.description: Infestation of head lice causing intense scalp itching and visible nits in hair.

pityriasis_rosea.name: Pityriasis Rosea
pityriasis_rosea.description: Mild skin rash that usually starts with one large oval patch followed by smaller patches on trunk.

porokeratosis.name: Porokeratosis
porokeratosis.description: Skin condition with thin border ring around raised patches. Some types have small cancer risk.

psoriasis.name: Psoriasis
psoriasis.description: Chronic autoimmune condition causing rapid skin cell buildup with thick, silvery scales.

seborrheic_keratosis.name: Seborrheic Keratosis
seborrheic_keratosis.description: Common benign skin growth appearing as waxy, scaly, slightly elevated lesions. Not dangerous.

squamous_cell_carcinoma.name: Squamous Cell Carcinoma
squamous_cell_carcinoma.description: Second most common skin cancer. Grows slowly but can spread if untreated.

tinea_corporis.name: Tinea Corporis (Ringworm)
tinea_corporis.description: Common fungal skin infection causing ring-shaped, itchy, red lesions on the body.

tinea_nigra.name: Tinea Nigra
tinea_nigra.description: Rare superficial fungal infection causing dark brown or black patches, typically on palms.

tungiasis.name: Tungiasis
tungiasis.description: Skin infestation by sand fleas, typically on feet, causing painful lesions.

vascular_lesion.name: Vascular Lesion
vascular_lesion.description: Abnormal collection of blood vessels under skin, appearing as red or purple marks.

nevus.name: Melanocytic Nevus (Mole)
nevus.description: Common benign growth of pigment cells. Can be flat or raised, brown or black.

pigmented_benign_keratosis.name: Pigmented Benign Keratosis
pigmented_benign_keratosis.description: Benign pigmented lesions that mimic melanoma. Requires proper examination to confirm benign.

healthy_normal.name: Healthy/Normal Skin
healthy_normal.description: No skin disease detected. The skin appears normal and healthy.

acne.name: Acne Vulgaris
acne.description: Very common skin condition caused by blocked hair follicles (oil + dead skin), leading to pimples, blackheads and painful cysts, usually on the face, back and shoulders.

hyperpigmentation.name: Hyperpigmentation (Dark Patches)
hyperpigmentation.description: Skin condition where patches turn darker than surrounding skin due to extra melanin, caused by sun exposure, inflammation, hormones or skin injuries.

eczema.name: Eczema (Atopic Dermatitis)
eczema.description: Very common condition causing dry, red, itchy, cracked skin with small blisters; often runs in families and flares up with irritants or allergies.

urticaria.name: Urticaria (Hives)
urticaria.description: Sudden raised, itchy red welts that appear on the skin and usually fade within hours to a day, caused by an allergic or immune reaction.

contact_dermatitis.name: Contact Dermatitis
contact_dermatitis.description: Red, itchy rash caused by direct contact with an irritant (chemicals, soap, plants like poison ivy) or an allergen.

alopecia.name: Hair Loss (Alopecia)
alopecia.description: Sudden or gradual loss of scalp or body hair; includes hereditary balding, patchy autoimmune hair loss, and hair breakage from styling.

nail_fungus.name: Nail Fungus (Onychomycosis)
nail_fungus.description: Fungal infection of fingernails or toenails causing thickening, yellowing, brittleness and white or brown discolouration of the nail.

scabies.name: Scabies
scabies.description: Very itchy skin infestation caused by tiny mites burrowing under the skin, spreading quickly through close contact and causing track-like rashes.

vasculitis.name: Vasculitis
vasculitis.description: Inflammation of blood vessels causing rash-like red or purple spots, mainly on the legs, along with skin ulcers; may need medical work-up.

bullous_disease.name: Bullous Disease (Blistering)
bullous_disease.description: Group of conditions that cause fluid-filled blisters on skin or mucous membranes; includes autoimmune blistering diseases (needs specialist care).

drug_eruption.name: Exanthem / Drug Eruption
drug_eruption.description: Skin rash appearing after starting a medicine or with viral illness - red blotchy bumps that may itch; usually resolves when medicine stops.

systemic_disease.name: Systemic Skin Disease
systemic_disease.description: Skin changes caused by a whole-body (systemic) condition such as diabetes, thyroid problems, kidney, liver or blood disorders, or internal infection.
